full_judgment: 4. Fourth opposite party of pre-emption miscellaneous case and first opposite party of Civil Revison petition contested pre-emption miscellaneous case on presentation of written objection traversing all material allegations contained in pre-emption miscellaneous case. Core contentions pressed into service, were that pre-emption proceeding land was adjacent to BS Plot Nos. 12079 and 12082 and they being, also, co-sharers of khatian expressed willingness to purchase land. Pre-emptor petitioner and pre-emptee opposite party side were of same kindred/family and they were intimately connected with each other. Consideration money amounting to Taka 80,000 had been settled with consent and mediation of pre-emptor-petitioner and his full brother opposite party No. 3. Preemptee opposite party side purchased pre-emption proceeding land by way of a sale deed dated 17-10-2001. Pre-emptee opposite party side got into possession on purchased land and remained in possession with full knowledge of pre-emptor-petitioner and, also, owners of adjoining land. Pre-emptee-opposite party side excavated a pond with full knowledge of pre-emptor-petitioner and incurred Taka 20,000 as expenditure. Pre-emptee opposite party side, also, raised banks of ponds and planted trees of different varieties. Preemptee opposite party side, also, constructed tin-shed house on land. Firm stand taken by preemptee opposite party side was that pre-emptor-petitioner and their other co-sharers had full consent leading to purchase of land and said land having been purchased with full knowledge of pre-emptor-petitioner, pre-emption case filed by pre-emptor-petitioner is untenable.
